summary.name: Axure RP
summary.one_liner: Axure RP is a desktop UX design tool for building interactive prototypes, specifications, and diagrams in one application.
use_cases: building interactive UX prototypes without code
creating wireframes and user flow diagrams
sharing prototypes with stakeholders for feedback
prototyping responsive desktop, tablet and phone layouts
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Axure RP as a tool for building prototypes with event triggers, conditions, variables, and actions triggered by mouse, touch, and keyboard. It includes widgets for working forms, text fields, droplists, radio buttons, dynamic panels for popups and swipeable mobile screens, and a repeater widget for sortable and filterable data tables. Diagramming tools with flow shapes and connectors sit alongside the prototypes, and notes can capture requirements. Prototypes can be published to Axure Cloud for feedback, with Slack and Microsoft Teams integrations, and embedded into Jira and Confluence. The page also lists import from Figma, Adobe XD, and Sketch.
notable: Prototypes with conditions, variables, and event triggers without code
Diagrams, specifications, and prototypes in one tool
Publishing to Axure Cloud with Jira and Confluence embedding
Imports frames and artboards from Figma, Adobe XD, and Sketch
caveats: Free 30-day fully-functional trial; continued use beyond the trial requires a purchase (paid tiers not detailed on this page)
Page describes only the free trial; full pricing is not stated here
